##### Project general facts

Divine Living Arjan is a contemporary residential development by Takmeel Development, located in the peaceful and fast-growing community of Arjan. Designed to offer a tranquil escape from the city's fast pace, the project features an exclusive collection of 118 spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments that combine elegant architecture with functional layouts. Surrounded by landscaped neighborhoods and just moments from Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden, Divine Living offers residents a balanced lifestyle where nature, comfort, and urban convenience come together seamlessly.

Residents benefit from excellent connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road and Umm Suqeim Street, providing quick access to Dubai’s major business districts, shopping destinations, schools, and leisure attractions. The family-friendly community is known for its quiet atmosphere, green surroundings, and growing infrastructure, making it an attractive choice for both homeowners and investors. A carefully selected range of lifestyle amenities further enhances everyday living, creating a welcoming environment focused on comfort, wellness, and convenience.

The residences are finished with premium-quality materials and elegant contemporary interiors that reflect timeless design and refined craftsmanship. A carefully curated color palette, high-quality finishes, and premium sanitary ware create sophisticated living spaces designed to stand the test of time. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, offering practicality and modern functionality. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Arjan, within the fast-growing Al Barsha South neighborhood, this exceptional location blends the warmth of a residential community with urban convenience. The area offers a well-established infrastructure with access to major shopping malls, international schools, healthcare facilities, and green parks, making it especially appealing to families and young professionals alike.

The location is distinguished by its excellent connectivity and peaceful environment. With direct access to key highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, residents enjoy smooth commutes to Dubai's main business and leisure hubs, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The area features ample parks, walking trails, fitness centers, and wellness facilities, creating a lifestyle that combines comfort, activity, and community. Nearby landmarks include Dubai Miracle Garden, Butterfly Garden, Dubai Autodrome, and Global Village.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern comfort, community connection, and a prime location, Arjan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tranquility, convenience, and a well-connected address makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — peaceful, connected and effortlessly refined.
